audit.why: EVEN 6/10 matches 50.3% over 1674 games; Renekton owns levels 2-3 and the first-item window, Warwick contests 4-6 and takes over on drain sustain.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row said Renekton on both layers, but the packet chart says Skill and every prose field on that row describes Warwick's healing taking over.
audit.why: whys[6] states his Q healing and sub-50% passive hyperhealing are at full strength and tells you not to chase — that is not a Renekton-favoured row. Packet levelChart[6] is 'Skill'.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] both to 'Skill', with phases[6].why restated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) appears nowhere in the matchup, and Jaws of the Beast was never identified as max-health damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: Primal Howl gives 2.5s of damage reduction and fears nearby enemies for 1s on expiry or re-activation, 15/14/13/12/11s. Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on your maximum health and heals him — stacking armour or HP reads that trade wrong. Infinite Duress is a 1.5s suppression on a 110/90/70s cooldown that hits the first champion it collides with.
audit.corrected: Fold Primal Howl's real numbers into the 4-5 row and state the max-health scaling on the anti-heal do.

edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and hits the first champion it collides with — 110s at rank 1, so bait it.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Land Infinite Duress' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Infinite Duress is the correct R name; the flag caught the leading verb. Real chart defect found and fixed as a matched pair: the 2+ items row said Renekton on both layers while the packet chart and the prose both say the drain-tank wins there. Primal Howl (E) was entirely absent from the matchup despite being his damage-reduction and fear button.
